title: 新加坡酒店获政府补助采用 AI 礼宾服务
titleEn: Singapore hotels to adopt AI concierge solutions with grant support
summary: 新加坡推出生产力补助计划，帮助酒店采用 AI 礼宾服务，以解决人力短缺问题，让员工专注于客户互动。
summaryEn: Singapore is offering productivity grants to help hotels adopt AI concierge solutions. The initiative aims to address manpower shortages while freeing staff to focus on guest engagement.
speaker: Ivy Chok
